residual_failure_and_escape_vectors.complementary_lever_needed: Use either autologous patient subcutaneous adipose microvessels (minimally invasive lipoaspirate) or hypoimmune (B2M-/-CIITA-/-CD47+) iPSC-derived microvascular fragments co-assembled with hypoimmune SC-islets.
